text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While at summer camp, Tamamo Cross tells me about a recent incident involving her younger brother. Apparently, he got into a fight with a neighborhood kid who argued that Oguri Cap was faster than Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Oguri Cap's running has mesmerized the public. Curious to know the secret to her charm, Tamamo Cross decides to press Oguri Cap herself for an answer this summer.
